Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Dubey,Ken Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1. Heard Sri Dheeraj Bahadur Singh and Sri Sushil Kumar Chaturvedi, Advocates for applicant and Sri Rakesh Kumar Mishra, learned AGA for State.
2. Applicant-Abhishek has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 297 of 2021, under Section 376(A), 506 IPC and 5M/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Malpura, District Agra.
3. Applicant before this Court is facing trial for offence of rape of a minor girl and he is in jail since 26.07.2021.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicant submits that during trial statement of victim has been recorded and he refers the same annexed alongwith supplementary affidavit that she has denied case of prosecution in its entirety and was declared hostile.
He also refers the statement of PW-1 (mother of victim), who also not supported case of prosecution though she has not declared hostile.
He further submits that on basis of above nature of evidence possibility of conviction appears to be very remote.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail, however, he could not deny the above referred nature of evidence.

6. Considering the above submissions and taking note that applicant is in jail since 26.07.2021 as well as taking note of above referred nature of evidence of victim, who has not supported case of prosecution and declared hostile as well as nature of evidence of her mother, this Court is of the view the applicant has made out a case for bail.

7. However, applicant is directed to remain present on each and every date as and when required by Trial Court during trial and in case any application for exemption on vague ground is filed, the same shall be a ground for Trial Court to cancel bail immediately.

8. Let the applicant-Abhishek be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment or exemption from appearance on the date fixed in trial.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iii) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.

(iv) The Trial Court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months after release of applicant,
if there is no other legal impediment.
9. The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

11. It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only for the purpose of adjudicating the present bail application.
